premises.text: HTML5 and current browsers have inherent flaws that prevent native-class 3D/2D performance
premises.evidence_span: there are inherent flaws that exist in the browser that make that impossible to do things like this

premises.text: Treating a game engine as an app engine delivers the 3D and 2D performance games already solved
premises.evidence_span: what if a game engine is an app engine

premises.text: Famo.us bypasses inefficient browser layers and talks mathematically directly to the GPU
premises.evidence_span: we're having a direct and beautiful mathematical conversation with the GPU

premises.text: The same engine runs across browsers, iOS, Android, PCs, Macs, and consoles wherever a GPU is accessible
premises.evidence_span: This solution abstracts out to every device that has a GPU and an operating system that can access it

premises.text: JavaScript engineers get a new tool that can outperform HTML5 and native for rich interfaces
premises.evidence_span: this gives JavaScript engineers a new tool in their tool belt that they didn't have before

premises.text: Democratizing 3D development requires bridging 2D templates to 3D as a settings option
premises.evidence_span: we won't succeed unless we build a bridge from the 2D world to the 3D world

value.text: Give designers and engineers performant 3D/2D web apps that feel better than HTML5 or native
value.evidence_span: HTML5 is good, native is better, but famous is the best

secondary_value.text: Make JavaScript engineers famous with a powerful new tool
